The classDc / attribute / spellcasting / UNSUPPORTED flags are an instrument misread — every one of those is carried by the psychic CLASS record plus its subconscious-mind choice option, not by the class-feature record.
The always-on +5-foot status bonus to Speed is delivered by nothing on our side — only the Overdrive rider is carried, as a star — so an inventor with Speed Boosters shows their unmodified Speed.

The curse's status penalty to AC and to saves is carried only as a prose mark on the cursebound condition row; no AC or save carrier applies it, so an oracle at cursebound 1-4 shows an unpenalised AC and unpenalised Fortitude/Reflex/Will.
Neither side models the Ghost Touch effect Spirit Rage gives the weapon, so a spirit barbarian striking an incorporeal creature sees no sign that the resistance to all damage does not apply.

Spirit Rage is a per-Rage choice; ours applies 3 spirit damage unconditionally, so a spirit barbarian who rages without taking the spirit option still sees 3 spirit instead of 2 of the weapon's own damage type.
The SET-GAP resistances flag is an instrument misread — both sides carry the same two Raging Resistance entries at the same value; only the label string differs.

The chosen initial construct modification is a label only — none of the seven modifications' mechanics (Speed, swim Speed, size, senses, the ranged unarmed attack, the three trained skills) reach the construct companion on either side.
A construct inventor never gets a modification picker at 7th or 15th level (nor the archetype's Basic Modification pick), while WG offers a modification select at each of those gates.

Two of our carriers speak for the same initial-modification pick and contradict each other: the record's own choice renders a 7-option picker while the Builder's innovation card tells the same player the modifications are text only.
The construct companion's share of Overdrive is modelled by neither side, so an Overdriven inventor's construct shows none of the extra damage it is owed (and none of the fire damage it risks).
The UNSUPPORTED flag is an instrument misread — every operation WG carries for this apparition is already delivered by our animist apparition option of the same id, exactly.

Elemental Blast prints as a 1- OR 2-action activity, but our record fixes its action cost at 1 action, so the 2-action blast (the one the sheet's own strike line actually renders, Con status bonus included) has no badge anywhere.
The printed rule that a non-physical damage type adds its trait to the blast is not applied: our blast strike's trait list never gains electricity/fire/cold/vitality.
The 'specialStat' flag on Elemental Blast is a comparer misread: WG's KINETICIST_BLAST_DICE variable has an exact carrier on our side, so it is not an unmodelled special stat.

Our stored text for the way replaces the printed access clause with a paraphrase, so the printed grant of triggerbrand access disappears — a mechanic neither side models and the player can no longer read.

The classDc / attribute / spellcasting flags on Emotional Acceptance are comparer misreads: all three of WG's ops have carriers on our side, on the psychic class record rather than on the class-feature record.

All three instrument flags on this record are comparer misreads: the way's deeds and its Deception-or-Intimidation choice are carried on the CLASS subclass option, not on the classFeatures record the comparer read.

flaggedResidues.id: flaggedResidue: the construct-companion applier for c.inventor.modifications is an unmodelled mechanic out of scope here. Six of the eighteen modifications carry companion mechanics and only two of the six have a CompanionMod field to land in (speeds, senses); Increased Size (Large), Durable Construction (+level max HP is a formula, not the flat maxHpBonus), Antimagic Construction (+2 circumstance to saves AND AC vs spells), Resistant Coating (resistance 5 all except adamantine), Miracle Gears (Int +2 plus two legendary skills of choice) and the Turret/Wall configurations (an activity that swaps the whole stat block) each need a new field plus a reader. Worse, no key channel reaches them: COMPANION_MODS is looked up through companionModKeys(character.feats), which only sees feat ids and feat choice answers, while an inventor modification lives on c.inventor.modifications and the construct is derived by deriveAnimalCompanion, whose only caller (src/sheet/CompanionsTab.tsx:1731) passes no character. Closing it means widening that key channel through a file no family in this batch owns. WG models none of it either (their Accelerated Mobility / Wonder Gears / Projectile Launcher ability blocks emit no operations), so this is a print lane, not a parity gap; until it is built the mechanics reach the player as the verbatim description prose in work/.b034-created-desc-gap-engine.json.

flaggedResidues.id: flaggedResidue: retiring the ungated grantsFeats ["diehard"] on classFeatures/scar-of-the-survivor is what ikon-13 prints (one Immanence sentence, one condition), but it also drops the exemplar's dying threshold from 5 to 4 even while the spark IS in this ikon, because the only numeric carrier is feats[].dyingThresholdBonus (src/rules/build.ts:6849 -> src/rules/conditions.ts:167 dyingDeathThreshold) and nothing gates it on immanence. The complete fix needs an immanence toggle-mode for this ikon in scripts/data/toggle-modes.json PLUS a mode field that can move a dying threshold — the mode schema has no such key today, so it is an engine-shape decision for the orchestrator, not a closer edit. Until then the clause reaches the player as the second Fortitude row of FEAT_SITUATIONAL['scar-of-the-survivor'], which states "you also gain the benefits of the Diehard feat" under "while your divine spark is in this ikon (immanence active)".
